name: Change to an unlocked Tier 1 Government through the official request and verify native production

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='NEEDS_TIER1_GOVERNMENT' and g.stage=='READY_CHANGE' and g.target.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and g.target.tier=='Tier1' and g.target.civicOwned and g.target.unlocked and d.spyID==655368 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'official Tier 1 Government gate or original captive differs'); b.Queue('CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'); return 'official Tier 1 Government request queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='REQUESTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

local i=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS'); local a=i and i.Tier1; local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return a and p and p:IsTurnActive() and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()==a.turn+1

local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='PENDING_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local i=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS')).Tier1; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_READ')); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='BUILD_TIER1' and p.buildingType and g.currentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and g.currentTier=='Tier1' and i.status=='PREPARED' and i.targetGovernment==g.currentType and i.targetIndex==r.governmentIndex and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.governmentType==g.currentType and r.governmentTier==g.currentTier and r.originalToken==i.token and r.originalTurn==i.turn and r.turn==i.turn+1 and r.frame>0 and r.token>i.token and r.spent==i.beforeSpent and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'native Government, Tier 1 production, title or original captive differs'); return p.stage
